description: Publish to a Facebook Page and its linked Instagram Business account

actions.description: Publish a post to the connected Facebook Page

params.message: Post text (required unless link or image_url is supplied)
params.link: URL to attach to the post (optional)
params.image_url: Publicly reachable image URL to attach as a photo post (optional)
params.scheduled_publish_time: ISO-8601 instant to schedule the post for (optional; immediate when omitted)

actions.description: Publish an image or video to the Instagram Business account linked to the connected Page

params.media_type: IMAGE, VIDEO or REELS (optional; defaults to IMAGE)
params.image_url: Publicly reachable image URL (required for IMAGE)
params.video_url: Publicly reachable video URL (required for VIDEO/REELS)
params.caption: Caption text, including any hashtags (optional)
